homograph.note: The verb 'air' (to state opinions or complaints publicly) and the everyday noun 'air' (the atmosphere) share one spelling and one pronunciation, but a learner who knows only the noun will not reach the verb sense; show them as separate blocks, and a mnemonic must name which sense it targets.

senses.definition: to express your opinions or complaints publicly so that other people hear them

examples.en: The meeting gave the staff a chance to air their complaints openly.
examples.fa: آن جلسه به کارکنان فرصت داد شکایت‌هایشان را آشکارا مطرح کنند.

senses.definition: the mixture of gases around the earth that we breathe

examples.en: The air in the mountains felt cold and wonderfully clean that morning.
examples.fa: آن روز صبح، هوای کوهستان سرد و به‌طرز دلپذیری پاک بود.

senses.definition: the particular appearance or manner that someone or something seems to have

examples.en: She answered every question with an air of complete confidence.
examples.fa: به هر پرسشی با حالتی سرشار از اطمینان پاسخ می‌داد.
